description: SD detection/markers and optional capability/validation checks. Device-specific logic limited to SD detection/markers, optional capability validation, and evidenced release differences.

detection.strategy: global TreeFrogUI markers — device-independent content, device-specific detection only where evidenced

markers.notes: Firmware + settings + game lists — present on all TreeFrogUI cards
BIOS folder — may not exist on fresh card, but manager creates on import
LGPT port assets — present when Bacon LGPT deployed

heuristics: At least cubegm/ + roms/ must exist to consider a volume a TreeFrogUI SD
Check for frogui/settings.txt or cubegm/xgame-logo.bmp as strong additional marker
Allow empty roms/ subfolders (user may not have added games yet)
Do NOT rely on Windows drive label alone

health_checks: probe via mount options + write probe (temp unique file then remove) only when explicitly requested
never auto-run fs repair — requires explicit user authorization (dirty exFAT caused false USB/bootstrap failures)
filesystem.notes: SD health: before blaming manager, verify mount healthy/writable/not read-only. TreeFrogUI + LGPT OTG modules include exFAT specifics.

allowed_differences: installation or release differences that are actually evidenced (e.g., install_first/<device>/ folder, boot logo, dtb/kernel for clones)
not_allowed: Fork the application into R36SX/SF3000/R36HD-specific ROM managers
Hardcode folder mappings per device in UI code — must live in declarative profiles

sd_layout_reference.hijack: install_first/<device>/ (r36sx, r36hd, sf3000, sf3500, sf3000hd, sf3100, gb350) — per-device autorun hijack; shared payload at cubegm/frogui/roms/MD
sd_layout_reference.install_contract: Stock OS + TreeFrogUI + payload to SD root = functional TreeFrogUI; log.txt enables logging
